title: Routine schedule
body: Cedar Club will train on Tuesday at 10 a.m. The gates open at 9:30. The announcement describes the schedule and makes no statement about anyone's feelings.
review_focus: Do not turn a routine schedule into excitement or hope.

title: Attributed current relief
body: Cedar Club player Alex said today, "I feel relieved and happy now that the test results have arrived." The reporter did not describe how other players or supporters feel.
review_focus: Relief and joy belong to Alex; a second copy does not add an independent witness.

title: Explicit denial of relief
body: Cedar Club player Alex said today, "I am not relieved. I do not feel happy about this." The reporter did not describe how other players or supporters feel.
review_focus: Mentioning relief and happiness while denying them must not establish current relief or joy.

title: Mixed emotions
body: Cedar Club player Alex said, "I am hopeful about our next match, but I am worried about the injury. Both feelings are there." No other speaker expressed an emotion.
review_focus: Preserve opposing optimism and worry, with one named speaker.

title: Dated historical hope
body: On March 2, Cedar Club player Alex said, "I feel hopeful about next season." Today's report quotes that old interview. Alex did not give a new statement about current feelings.
review_focus: Past hope is not a measurement of current emotion.

title: Other entity
body: Maple Club player Robin said, "I am delighted and proud of our win." This report contains no information about Cedar Club or its players.
review_focus: Emotion in Maple reporting does not establish Cedar emotion or relevance.

title: Sarcastic praise
body: After Cedar Club lost again, supporter Robin wrote sarcastically, "Fantastic, another defeat. Just what we needed." The report attributes the comment to Robin alone.
review_focus: Sarcasm is not literal joy; one supporter does not speak for the fanbase.

title: Two separate speakers
body: Cedar Club player Alex said, "I am excited about returning." Maple Club player Robin said, "I am afraid of another setback." The reporter made no claim that Alex was afraid or Robin was excited.
review_focus: Article-level scores cannot assign one speaker's feelings to another.
